_comment: Shared merge contract for the GameStatistics model JSON.
This file is BYTE-IDENTICAL to the copy in the backend repository at
Each side asserts its own field lists against its own copy, so adding a
counter on one side and forgetting the other turns into a failing test
instead of a silent data-loss bug: the repo you edited fails until you
update its fixture, and updating the fixture fails the OTHER repo until
The two repos are checked out independently, so a cross-repo file read
would be unreliable in CI — duplicating the fixture is what makes the
drift detectable from either side alone.
